biggest_catch: Balance-tiered: the minimum tier requires parking $30,000 of new-to-Citibank money for 90 days ($1,500 needs $200,000); the 45th-day balance locks in your maximum bonus tier.
catches: Open a new Regular Checking account 4/14/26-10/26/26 and enroll in the bonus offer the same day (apply directly from the offer page).
Deposit New-to-Citibank Funds within 45 calendar days; the balance on the 45th day determines your maximum bonus: $30,000 minimum for $500, $200,000 for $1,500.
Maintain the required minimum balance for an additional 45 days from the 46th day (through roughly day 90).
Withdrawals during the maintenance period are allowed, but at least $30,000 must remain to keep the minimum $500 bonus eligible.
Bonus is paid to the open Regular Checking account between the 90th and 120th calendar day after account opening, provided the account is kept open and in good standing.
Balance may be split between the new Checking and a new Citi Savings Account to count toward the minimum.
No direct deposit required - this is a pure new-money balance bonus.
Bonus is taxable income (standard bank-bonus tax treatment).
Fees may reduce earnings; monthly service fees avoidable with $250+ in Enhanced Direct Deposits.
